exam_set.title: Practice Set 2
exam_set.description: Textbook Practice — Book 1, Chapter 15, Practice Set 2

questions.jp: “システム管理基準”に基づいて、システムの信頼性、安全性、効率性を監査する際に、システムが不正な使用から保護されているかどうかという安全性の検証項目として、最も適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: 'Shisutemu kanri kijun' ni motozuite, shisutemu no shinraisei, anzensei, kōritsusei o kansa suru sai ni, shisutemu ga fusei na shiyō kara hogo sarete iru ka dō ka to iu anzensei no kenshō kōmoku to shite, mottomo tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Under the System Management Standards, which audit item best verifies whether a system is protected against unauthorized use?

options.label: ア
options.jp: アクセス管理機能の検証
options.romaji: Akusesu kanri kinō no kenshō
options.en: Verify access-control functions.

options.label: イ
options.jp: フェールソフト機能の検証
options.romaji: Fēru sofuto kinō no kenshō
options.en: Verify fail-soft functions.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: フォールトトレラント機能の検証
options.romaji: Fōruto toreranto kinō no kenshō
options.en: Verify fault-tolerant functions.

options.label: エ
options.jp: リカバリ機能の検証
options.romaji: Rikabari kinō no kenshō
options.en: Verify recovery functions.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Imagine an office where employees carry ID cards. The entrance proves whose card it is, and each internal door checks whether that person may enter that room. A computer similarly proves an identity before login and decides which files or functions it may use. Proving identity is authentication; granting permitted resources is authorization; entry records support investigation. Together these checks stop unknown or insufficiently permitted people. An audit for unauthorized-use protection examines access control.

Technical breakdown:
Protection from improper use requires authentication, authorization, account management, and access logging. These controls prevent or detect use by unauthorized identities and excessive privileges. The other functions address failure continuity or restoration.

Japanese keywords to remember:
不正な使用 = fusei na shiyō = unauthorized use
アクセス管理 = akusesu kanri = access control
安全性 = anzensei = security

Why the best solution works:
ア directly verifies the control designed to restrict system use.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
Fail-soft preserves limited service after failure.
ウ:
Fault tolerance continues operation despite component faults.
エ:
Recovery restores service or data after failure.

Memory trick:
Unauthorized use → access control.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: システムに関わるドキュメントが漏えい、改ざん、不正使用されるリスクに対するコントロールを監査する際のチェックポイントはどれか。
questions.romaji: Shisutemu ni kakawaru dokyumento ga rōei, kaizan, fusei shiyō sareru risuku ni taisuru kontorōru o kansa suru sai no chekku pointo wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which checkpoint audits controls against leakage, alteration, or unauthorized use of system documents?

options.label: ア
options.jp: システムの変更に伴い、ドキュメントを遅滞なく更新していること
options.romaji: Shisutemu no henkō ni tomonai, dokyumento o chitai naku kōshin shite iru koto
options.en: Documents are updated promptly when the system changes.

options.label: イ
options.jp: ドキュメントの機密性を確保するための対策を講じていること
options.romaji: Dokyumento no kimitsusei o kakuho suru tame no taisaku o kōjite iru koto
options.en: Measures are taken to ensure document confidentiality.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: ドキュメントの標準化を行っていること
options.romaji: Dokyumento no hyōjunka o okonatte iru koto
options.en: Documents are standardized.

options.label: エ
options.jp: プロトタイプ型開発においても、必要なドキュメントを作成していること
options.romaji: Purototaipu-gata kaihatsu ni oite mo, hitsuyō na dokyumento o sakusei shite iru koto
options.en: Required documents are created even in prototype development.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
System documents may reveal layouts or procedures useful to attackers. Treat them like confidential building plans: store them securely and limit who may read, copy, change, or remove them. Prompt updates improve accuracy and standard formats improve consistency, but neither prevents disclosure. The stated risk is leakage, alteration, or unauthorized use. Measures preserving confidentiality address it.

Technical breakdown:
The stated risks concern confidentiality, integrity, and authorized use. Measures such as classification, permissions, secure storage, encryption, controlled copying, and disposal directly address those risks.

Japanese keywords to remember:
漏えい = rōei = leakage
改ざん = kaizan = alteration
機密性 = kimitsusei = confidentiality

Why the best solution works:
イ checks protection aligned with the document exposure risk.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Timely updates protect currency and consistency, not mainly confidentiality.
ウ:
Standardization improves uniformity.
エ:
Creating documents addresses completeness, not unauthorized disclosure or use.

Memory trick:
Leak risk → confidentiality controls.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: 情報セキュリティ監査において、可用性を確認するチェック項目はどれか。
questions.romaji: Jōhō sekyuriti kansa ni oite, kayōsei o kakunin suru chekku kōmoku wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which information-security audit item checks availability?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 外部記憶媒体の無断持出しが禁止されていること
options.romaji: Gaibu kioku baitai no mudan mochidashi ga kinshi sarete iru koto
options.en: Unauthorized removal of external storage media is prohibited.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 中断時間を定めたSLAの水準が保たれるように管理されていること
options.romaji: Chūdan jikan o sadameta SLA no suijun ga tamotareru yō ni kanri sarete iru koto
options.en: Management maintains SLA levels that specify interruption time.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: データ入力時のエラーチェックが適切に行われていること
options.romaji: Dēta nyūryokuji no erā chekku ga tekisetsu ni okonawarete iru koto
options.en: Input error checks are performed appropriately.

options.label: エ
options.jp: データベースが暗号化されていること
options.romaji: Dētabēsu ga angōka sarete iru koto
options.en: The database is encrypted.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Availability means legitimate users can use a service when promised. An online store agreement might limit how long checkout may be down, so managers keep outages within that limit. Disk-removal rules and encryption protect secrecy; input checks protect correctness. Those controls answer different questions. An SLA specifying interruption time measures availability.

Technical breakdown:
An SLA interruption-time target measures and controls service accessibility and recovery, directly supporting availability. Media removal and encryption mainly protect confidentiality; input validation protects integrity.

Japanese keywords to remember:
可用性 = kayōsei = availability
中断時間 = chūdan jikan = interruption time
SLAの水準 = SLA no suijun = SLA level

Why the best solution works:
イ verifies that downtime remains within the agreed availability target.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Media-removal restrictions mainly prevent information leakage.
ウ:
Input error checks protect data integrity.
エ:
Encryption protects confidentiality.

Memory trick:
Availability audit looks for uptime and recovery commitments.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: システム監査人が実施するヒアリングに関する記述のうち、最も適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Shisutemu kansanin ga jisshi suru hiaringu ni kansuru kijutsu no uchi, mottomo tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement about interviews conducted by a system auditor is most appropriate?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 監査業務を経験したことのある被監査部門の管理者をヒアリングの対象者として選ぶ。
options.romaji: Kansa gyōmu o keiken shita koto no aru hi-kansa bumon no kanrisha o hiaringu no taishōsha to shite erabu.
options.en: Select a manager in the audited department who has audit-work experience.

options.label: イ
options.jp: ヒアリングで被監査部門から得た情報を裏付けるための文書や記録を入手するよう努める。
options.romaji: Hiaringu de hi-kansa bumon kara eta jōhō o urazukeru tame no bunsho ya kiroku o nyūshu suru yō tsutomeru.
options.en: Seek documents and records that corroborate information obtained in interviews.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: ヒアリングの中で気が付いた不備事項について、その場で被監査部門に改善を指示する。
options.romaji: Hiaringu no naka de ki ga tsuita fubi jikō ni tsuite, sono ba de hi-kansa bumon ni kaizen o shiji suru.
options.en: Immediately instruct the audited department to improve deficiencies noticed during the interview.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 複数人でヒアリングを行うと記録内容に相違が出ることがあるので、1人のシステム監査人が行う。
options.romaji: Fukusūnin de hiaringu o okonau to kiroku naiyō ni sōi ga deru koto ga aru node, hitori no shisutemu kansanin ga okonau.
options.en: Use only one auditor because multiple interviewers may produce differing records.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
An interview is one person's account, so an auditor seeks independent support. If a manager says backups succeeded, compare the claim with logs, schedules, and error records. Agreement makes the evidence stronger. The auditor gathers evidence rather than immediately operating the department or ordering fixes. Supporting interview information with records is corroboration.

Technical breakdown:
Audit evidence must be sufficient, reliable, relevant, and useful. Interview statements alone are weaker than corroborated evidence, so auditors compare them with documents, logs, records, observation, or re-performance.

Japanese keywords to remember:
ヒアリング = hiaringu = interview
裏付ける = urazukeru = corroborate
文書や記録 = bunsho ya kiroku = documents and records

Why the best solution works:
イ strengthens oral information with objective supporting evidence.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Interviewees are chosen for relevant duties and knowledge, not audit experience.
ウ:
The auditor evaluates and reports; immediate operational instruction can impair independence.
エ:
Multiple auditors may improve completeness when roles and records are coordinated.

Memory trick:
Interview says; evidence proves.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: システム監査の実施体制に関する記述のうち、適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Shisutemu kansa no jisshi taisei ni kansuru kijutsu no uchi, tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement about the system-audit organization is appropriate?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 監査依頼者が監査報告に基づく改善指示を行えるように、システム監査人は監査結果を監査依頼者に報告する。
options.romaji: Kansa iraisha ga kansa hōkoku ni motozuku kaizen shiji o okonaeru yō ni, shisutemu kansanin wa kansa kekka o kansa iraisha ni hōkoku suru.
options.en: The auditor reports results to the audit requester so the requester can issue improvement instructions.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 業務監査の一部として情報システムの監査を行う場合には、利用部門のメンバーによる監査チームを編成して行う。
options.romaji: Gyōmu kansa no ichibu to shite jōhō shisutemu no kansa o okonau baai ni wa, riyō bumon no menbā ni yoru kansa chīmu o hensei shite okonau.
options.en: When auditing systems as part of an operational audit, form the team from user-department members.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: システム監査人が他の専門家の支援を受ける場合には、支援の範囲・方法、及び監査結果の判断は、他の専門家の責任において行う。
options.romaji: Shisutemu kansanin ga hoka no senmonka no shien o ukeru baai ni wa, shien no han'i hōhō, oyobi kansa kekka no handan wa, hoka no senmonka no sekinin ni oite okonau.
options.en: When specialists assist, their scope, methods, and audit-result judgment are their responsibility.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 情報システム部門における開発状況の監査を行う場合には、開発内容を熟知した情報システム部門のメンバーによる監査チームを編成して行う。
options.romaji: Jōhō shisutemu bumon ni okeru kaihatsu jōkyō no kansa o okonau baai ni wa, kaihatsu naiyō o jukuchi shita jōhō shisutemu bumon no menbā ni yoru kansa chīmu o hensei shite okonau.
options.en: Audit development using a team of information-system department members familiar with that development.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A system auditor is an independent inspector, not the audited department's manager. The auditor examines evidence and reports findings to the audit requester. Responsible management then decides improvement orders. Using only people whose work is examined weakens independence. Specialists may help, but the auditor retains final judgment.

Technical breakdown:
Audit responsibility separates independent evaluation from management action. Results go to the audit requester or appropriate authority, who owns corrective direction. Auditing one's own department or transferring final audit judgment to a specialist undermines auditor independence and responsibility.

Japanese keywords to remember:
監査依頼者 = kansa iraisha = audit requester
監査結果 = kansa kekka = audit results
改善指示 = kaizen shiji = improvement instruction

Why the best solution works:
ア preserves proper reporting and management accountability.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
User-department members auditing their own area may lack independence.
ウ:
The system auditor retains responsibility for scope and conclusions when using experts.
エ:
Developers auditing their own development creates self-review risk.

Memory trick:
Auditor reports; management directs corrections.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: アクセス制御を監査するシステム監査人の行為のうち、適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Akusesu seigyo o kansa suru shisutemu kansanin no kōi no uchi, tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which action by a system auditor auditing access control is appropriate?

options.label: ア
options.jp: ソフトウェアに関するアクセス制御の管理台帳を作成し、保管した。
options.romaji: Sofutowea ni kansuru akusesu seigyo no kanri daichō o sakusei shi, hokan shita.
options.en: Create and retain an access-control ledger for software.

options.label: イ
options.jp: データに関するアクセス制御の管理規程を閲覧した。
options.romaji: Dēta ni kansuru akusesu seigyo no kanri kitei o etsuran shita.
options.en: Inspect the access-control management rules for data.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: ネットワークに関するアクセス制御の管理方針を制定した。
options.romaji: Nettowāku ni kansuru akusesu seigyo no kanri hōshin o seitei shita.
options.en: Establish an access-control policy for networks.

options.label: エ
options.jp: ハードウェアに関するアクセス制御の運用手続を実施した。
options.romaji: Hādowea ni kansuru akusesu seigyo no un'yō tetsuzuki o jisshi shita.
options.en: Execute access-control operating procedures for hardware.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A fire inspector checks safety rules and records but does not operate alarms daily. Likewise, access policies, ledgers, and procedures belong to management. A system auditor inspects whether rules exist and are followed. Taking over operations would damage independence. Auditing means examining controls, not performing them.

Technical breakdown:
Reading access-control regulations is a read-only evidence-gathering activity consistent with auditor independence. Creating ledgers, establishing policy, or executing operational procedures are management or operational duties and would create self-review risk.

Japanese keywords to remember:
アクセス制御 = akusesu seigyo = access control
管理規程 = kanri kitei = management rules
閲覧した = etsuran shita = inspected

Why the best solution works:
イ gathers audit evidence without assuming control ownership.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Creating and retaining the ledger is an operational responsibility.
ウ:
Establishing policy is a management function.
エ:
Executing procedures makes the auditor an operator.

Memory trick:
Auditors inspect controls; they do not operate them.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: 情報システム部が開発して経理部が運用している会計システムの運用状況を、経営者からの指示で監査することになった。この場合におけるシステム監査人についての記述のうち、最も適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Jōhō shisutemu-bu ga kaihatsu shite keiri-bu ga un'yō shite iru kaikei shisutemu no un'yō jōkyō o, keieisha kara no shiji de kansa suru koto ni natta. Kono baai ni okeru shisutemu kansanin ni tsuite no kijutsu no uchi, mottomo tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Management orders an audit of an accounting system developed by IT and operated by accounting. Which statement about the system auditor is most appropriate?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 会計システムは企業会計に関する各種基準に準拠すべきなので、システム監査人を公認会計士とする。
options.romaji: Kaikei shisutemu wa kigyō kaikei ni kansuru kakushu kijun ni junkyo subeki na node, shisutemu kansanin o kōnin kaikeishi to suru.
options.en: Use a certified public accountant because the system must comply with accounting standards.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 会計システムは機密性の高い情報を扱うので、システム監査人は経理部長直属とする。
options.romaji: Kaikei shisutemu wa kimitsusei no takai jōhō o atsukau node, shisutemu kansanin wa keiri buchō chokuzoku to suru.
options.en: Place the auditor directly under the accounting manager because the system handles confidential data.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: システム監査を効率的に行うために、システム監査人は情報システム部長直属とする。
options.romaji: Shisutemu kansa o kōritsuteki ni okonau tame ni, shisutemu kansanin wa jōhō shisutemu buchō chokuzoku to suru.
options.en: Place the auditor directly under the IT manager for audit efficiency.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 独立性を担保するために、システム監査人は情報システム部にも経理部にも所属しない者とする。
options.romaji: Dokuritsusei o tanpo suru tame ni, shisutemu kansanin wa jōhō shisutemu-bu ni mo keiri-bu ni mo shozoku shinai mono to suru.
options.en: To ensure independence, use an auditor belonging to neither IT nor accounting.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
An independent referee cannot belong to either team. IT built this accounting system and accounting operates it, so both have work under examination. Placing the auditor under either manager creates self-review or pressure. Expertise alone does not remove that conflict. Independence requires an auditor from neither department.

Technical breakdown:
Organizational independence protects impartial conclusions. IT developed the system and accounting operates it, so an auditor reporting within either department faces self-interest or pressure. Professional knowledge can be supplemented without sacrificing independence.

Japanese keywords to remember:
独立性 = dokuritsusei = independence
担保する = tanpo suru = ensure
所属しない = shozoku shinai = not belong to

Why the best solution works:
エ removes direct organizational ties to both audited parties.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
A CPA may help, but qualification alone does not establish independence.
イ:
Reporting to accounting compromises independence from the operator.
ウ:
Reporting to IT compromises independence from the developer.

Memory trick:
Audit independently of builder and operator.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: システム運用業務のオペレーション管理に関する監査で判明した状況のうち、指摘事項として監査報告書に記載すべきものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Shisutemu un'yō gyōmu no operēshon kanri ni kansuru kansa de hanmei shita jōkyō no uchi, shiteki jikō to shite kansa hōkokusho ni kisai subeki mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which condition found in an operations-management audit should be reported as a finding?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 運用責任者が、オペレータの作成したオペレーション記録を確認している。
options.romaji: Un'yō sekininsha ga, operēta no sakusei shita operēshon kiroku o kakunin shite iru.
options.en: The operations manager checks operation records created by operators.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 運用責任者が、期間を定めてオペレーション記録を保管している。
options.romaji: Un'yō sekininsha ga, kikan o sadamete operēshon kiroku o hokan shite iru.
options.en: The operations manager retains operation records for a defined period.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: オペレータが、オペレーション中に起きた例外処理を記録している。
options.romaji: Operēta ga, operēshon-chū ni okita reigai shori o kiroku shite iru.
options.en: Operators record exception processing occurring during operations.

options.label: エ
options.jp: オペレータが、日次の運用計画を決定し、自ら承認している。
options.romaji: Operēta ga, nichiji no un'yō keikaku o kettei shi, mizukara shōnin shite iru.
options.en: An operator decides the daily operation plan and approves it personally.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Approval works only as an independent second check. One operator writing and approving a plan resembles signing one's own expense claim. Records, exception logs, and manager review create accountability. Self-approval removes separation of duties. An auditor should report that weakness.

Technical breakdown:
Segregation of duties prevents errors or misuse from passing unchecked. Operators may execute and record work, while an authorized responsible person should approve operational plans. Self-approval removes preventive oversight.

Japanese keywords to remember:
日次の運用計画 = nichiji no un'yō keikaku = daily operation plan
自ら承認 = mizukara shōnin = self-approval
指摘事項 = shiteki jikō = audit finding

Why the best solution works:
エ violates separation between preparation/execution and authorization.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Manager review of operator records is an appropriate control.
イ:
Defined record retention supports accountability.
ウ:
Recording exceptions creates necessary audit evidence.

Memory trick:
Maker and approver should differ.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: 企業経営の透明性を確保するために、企業は誰のために経営を行っているか、トップマネジメントの構造はどうなっているか、組織内部に自浄能力をもっているかなどの視点で、企業活動を監督・監視する仕組みはどれか。
questions.romaji: Kigyō keiei no tōmeisei o kakuho suru tame ni, kigyō wa dare no tame ni keiei o okonatte iru ka, toppu manejimento no kōzō wa dō natte iru ka, soshiki naibu ni jijō nōryoku o motte iru ka nado no shiten de, kigyō katsudō o kantoku kanshi suru shikumi wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which mechanism supervises corporate activity from perspectives such as whom the company serves, top-management structure, and internal self-correction to ensure management transparency?

options.label: ア
options.jp: コアコンピタンス
options.romaji: Koa konpitansu
options.en: Core competence

options.label: イ
options.jp: コーポレートアイデンティティ
options.romaji: Kōporēto aidentiti
options.en: Corporate identity

options.label: ウ
options.jp: コーポレートガバナンス
options.romaji: Kōporēto gabanansu
options.en: Corporate governance

options.label: エ
options.jp: ステークホルダアナリシス
options.romaji: Sutēkuhoruda anarishisu
options.en: Stakeholder analysis

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Corporate governance is the guardrail around leadership. Boards, oversight, reporting, and correction mechanisms keep executives accountable. Think of who steers, who watches the driver, and how bad decisions are corrected. Strengths, public identity, and stakeholder lists are different ideas. Transparent direction is corporate governance.

Technical breakdown:
Governance defines oversight structures, board responsibilities, stakeholder accountability, internal controls, disclosure, and checks on management power. These mechanisms monitor corporate conduct and support organizational self-correction.

Japanese keywords to remember:
透明性 = tōmeisei = transparency
監督・監視 = kantoku kanshi = supervision and monitoring
コーポレートガバナンス = kōporēto gabanansu = corporate governance

Why the best solution works:
ウ names the company-wide direction and oversight framework described.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Core competence is a distinctive capability creating competitive advantage.
イ:
Corporate identity expresses the organization's image and values.
エ:
Stakeholder analysis identifies and evaluates interested parties; it is not the oversight system itself.

Memory trick:
Governance governs the governors.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: 我が国の証券取引所に上場している企業において、内部統制の整備及び運用に最終的な責任を負っている者は誰か。
questions.romaji: Waga kuni no shōken torihikijo ni jōjō shite iru kigyō ni oite, naibu tōsei no seibi oyobi un'yō ni saishūteki na sekinin o otte iru mono wa dare ka.
questions.en: In a company listed on a Japanese stock exchange, who bears ultimate responsibility for establishing and operating internal control?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 株主
options.romaji: Kabunushi
options.en: Shareholders

options.label: イ
options.jp: 監査役
options.romaji: Kansayaku
options.en: Corporate auditor

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 業務担当者
options.romaji: Gyōmu tantōsha
options.en: Operational staff

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Internal controls keep operations, reporting, and compliance reliable. Employees perform daily checks and auditors examine them, but management directs the company and fixes weaknesses. A ship's officers inspect equipment, yet the captain remains responsible for safety. Shareholders and auditors oversee rather than operate controls. Ultimate responsibility stays with management.

Technical breakdown:
Under internal-control reporting principles, management bears ultimate responsibility for designing, implementing, operating, and evaluating internal control. Auditors independently assess it, employees perform assigned controls, and shareholders exercise ownership rights.

Japanese keywords to remember:
内部統制 = naibu tōsei = internal control
最終的な責任 = saishūteki na sekinin = ultimate responsibility
経営者 = keieisha = management

Why the best solution works:
エ has authority over organizational processes and therefore owns the final responsibility for internal control.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Shareholders own the company but do not operate its control system.
イ:
Corporate auditors supervise and audit management rather than owning daily control operation.
ウ:
Operational staff execute controls but do not bear enterprise-wide ultimate responsibility.

Memory trick:
Management manages internal control; auditors audit it.

Correct answer: エ
